objectives: Explain why Jacob feared meeting Esau and how he prayed.
Describe the wrestling at Peniel and what it teaches about faith.
Explain the meaning of the name Israel.
takeaways: The hosts are the armies of angels; Jacob saw God's host at Mahanaim.
Jacob prayed humbly and pleaded the covenant; that is the pattern for our prayers.
A man's gift maketh room for him (Proverbs 18:16): Jacob sent a present ahead to appease Esau.
I will not let thee go, except thou bless me: cleave unto Him and depart not away (Ecclesiasticus 2:3).
Israel means a prince that has power with God; the God of Israel gives strength and power unto His people (Psalms 68:35).
